description: Creates an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP snapshot policy. A snapshot policy defines up to five schedules that automatically create and retain volume snapshots. A snapshot policy is scoped either to a file system or to a storage virtual machine (SVM).

SnapshotPolicyId.description: The system-generated, unique ID of the snapshot policy.
SnapshotPolicyId.markdownDescription:
The system-generated, unique ID of the snapshot policy.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 29  
Maximum Length: 29  
Pattern: ^snapshotpol-[0-9a-f]{17}$  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

ResourceARN.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the snapshot policy.
ResourceARN.markdownDescription:
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the snapshot policy.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 8  
Maximum Length: 512  
Pattern: ^arn:(?=[^:]+:fsx:[^:]+:\d{12}:)((|(?=[a-z0-9-.]{1,63})(?!\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3})(?![^:]*-{2})(?![^:]*-\.)(?![^:]*\.-)[a-z0-9].*(?<!-)):){4}(?!/).{0,1024}$  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

FileSystemId.description: The ID of the FSx for ONTAP file system on which to create a file system-scoped snapshot policy. Specify exactly one of FileSystemId or StorageVirtualMachineId.
FileSystemId.markdownDescription:
The ID of the FSx for ONTAP file system on which to create a file system-scoped snapshot policy. Specify exactly one of FileSystemId or StorageVirtualMachineId.

---

Required: Conditional  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 11  
Maximum Length: 21  
Pattern: ^(fs-[0-9a-f]{8,})$  
Update requires: Replacement

StorageVirtualMachineId.description: The ID of the storage virtual machine (SVM) on which to create an SVM-scoped snapshot policy. Specify exactly one of FileSystemId or StorageVirtualMachineId.
StorageVirtualMachineId.markdownDescription:
The ID of the storage virtual machine (SVM) on which to create an SVM-scoped snapshot policy. Specify exactly one of FileSystemId or StorageVirtualMachineId.

---

Required: Conditional  
Type: String

Maximum Length: 21  
Pattern: ^(svm-[0-9a-f]{17,})$  
Update requires: Replacement

Name.markdownDescription:
The name of the snapshot policy.
